text:
Alex W: hey team — quick ping for eyes on PR #2742: terraform: attach GPU pool ENIs to new vpc-subnet. This touches tf/modules/gpu-pool and tf/modules/vpc-routing. https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2742
Maria P: looking now, ping me if you want a quick walkthrough
Sam K: can do review in ~30m, assigning to myself for now
infra-bot: terraform/plan posted for PR #2742 — see check details (ci link)
Alex W: thanks — main changes: add subnet mapping, update eni attachment count, add route propagation rule. plan shows 3 adds, 2 mods, 0 deletes. also note canary tag "gpu-canary" added to new pool
Devops-alert: quick question — do we need an explicit security_group_id on the ENI? last time we left it implicit and hit SG drift
Alex W: good call — added sg_id var and wired it to the module; default is existing-gpu-sg but customers can override
Olivia R: CI lint is failing on formatting in tf/modules/vpc-routing/main.tf — run `make fmt` and re-push, then reprovision plan
Alex W: ok will run format and force-push in ~10m
Maria P: small comment: replace count with for_each on eni attachments to avoid index fragility — otherwise looks fine
Sam K: left a couple of nit comments on naming and a doc note about canary rollout timing
Alex W: applied Maria & Sam feedback, pushed a single squashed commit. Plan now shows same actions.
infra-bot: checks passed: terraform/plan, terraform/lint
John L: heads-up — canary window tonight 22:00 UTC; if this needs manual rollback we should coordinate on #incidents-channel
Alex W: noted — my plan is to merge once we have 2 approvals and CI green, run canary at 22:00 UTC and monitor logs for 30m. If no issues, promote after 3 hours
Maria P: approved :thumbsup:
Sam K: approved, please squash commits (already squashed) — I'll merge after you confirm final plan is green
Alex W: final plan green, merging in ~5 unless any objections
Olivia R: no objections from security side, thanks for adding sg_id
Alex W: merged and triggered canary deploy — will post results
infra-bot: deploy/canary started for gpu-pool (canary id: c-8721)
Alex W: result: canary healthy after 30m, promoting to full pool now
Alex W: thanks all for quick reviews!
